services.desc: Interested in touring our permanent exhibition? Book a student or adult tour to get started. Learn about the elements that make up our permanent exhibitions including our Pride Overcomes Prejudice exhibition. Connect with us to learn about our permanent exhibitions and our available touring options. Pride Overcomes Prejudice considers the history of peoples of African descent in Charlottesville. Beginning with an examination of enslavement in Albemarle County, it suggests the importance of chattel labor by considering the conditions that allowed the area to become the 4th richest slave holding region in the Commonwealth. blurb: Located in the Jefferson School City Center, The Jefferson School African American Heritage Center’s mission is to honor and preserve the rich heritage and legacy of the African-American community of Charlottesville-Albemarle, Virginia and to promote a greater appreciation for, and understanding of, the contributions of African Americans and peoples of the Diaspora locally, nationally.
